name: The Glowing Shard
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, you find a green shard whose smoky depths stir unease. Its mystery draws you to Ratchet and onward.

sections.title: A Disturbing Discovery
sections.body: You carry a green crystal from deep within the Wailing Caverns. Beneath its bright, solid face, shadowy wisps seem to churn. Those who touch it feel uneasy, and its strange presence hints at the corruption around the sleeping druids and their nightmare-haunted sanctuary.

sections.title: Seeking Answers in Ratchet
sections.body: In Ratchet, the shard's origin remains unclear. Engineer Sputtervalve examines it, but goblin machinery and ordinary geology cannot explain its nature. He points you toward the rocky ridges above the caverns, where Falla Sagewind, a tauren mystic, watches over the troubled spirits of the Barrens.

faq.answer: You found the Glowing Shard deep within the Wailing Caverns. Faint smoky shapes swirl beneath its glassy surface and unsettle those who study it.

faq.q: Who can examine the shard in Ratchet?
aliases: who in ratchet looks at shard
faq.answer: Engineer Sputtervalve near Ratchet's flight master can examine the shard. Its strange energy leads him to point you toward someone with spiritual knowledge.
Falla Sagewind keeps her camp on the mountain peaks directly above the Wailing Caverns entrance in the central Barrens.

faq.q: Does Sputtervalve have a quest marker over his head?
faq.answer: No. Sputtervalve has no active icon above his head. Speak with him and choose the dialogue about the strange glowing shard to continue.

faq.q: Why does the shard look like it contains smoke?
faq.answer: The smoke-like swirl reflects corruption spreading through the Wailing Caverns. It is bound to the Emerald Nightmare invading the thoughts of the sleeping Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: Who can complete the quest chain after Falla Sagewind?
faq.answer: Horde and Alliance adventurers can both follow the story. Falla Sagewind's findings lead to In Nightmares, where heroes seek guidance from their own leaders and elders.

angles.text: As a druid, you may see the shard's emerald sheen and smoky heart as grim signs of the Emerald Nightmare reaching the waking world through your fallen brethren in the Wailing Caverns.
As a tauren, you know the Barrens' balance matters to the Shu'halo. Bringing this unnatural relic to Falla Sagewind can help reveal the corruption poisoning your ancestral lands.
As a member of the Horde, you can help uncover the shard's mystery and guard the Barrens' crossroads and trade routes from threats festering in the underground springs.
As an Alliance explorer far from home in Kalimdor, you can see the danger in a dark power corrupting nature beneath the Barrens.
